title: Large Army installation Attachment J-0302 facility list workbook: 420 in-scope facilities in six zones (UEPH, COF, BN/BDE HQ, TEMF, DFAC, chapels, PFCs, CDCs, clinics, warehouses, range latrines/towers, gatehouses) plus a Grounds sheet of improved / semi-improved / unimproved acres by cantonment zone and training area (scale test)

sources.note: Army Facilities Pricing Guide (PAX 3.2.2, 2017): CATCODE 14185 COMPANY OPERATIONS FACILITY (COF), 21410 tactical equipment maintenance facilities (TEMF) in small/medium/large sizes, 72210 dining facility entries, 72111 among the enlisted housing codes. Used for those CATCODE assignments only.

USACE unit costs for Army facilities: 14183 BATTALION HQS BLDG W/ CLASSROOMS, 14182 brigade headquarters building, 74042 indoor swimming pool as a code separate from the fitness center. Used for those CATCODE assignments.
FY05 facility unit cost table: 21410 VEHICLE MAINT SHOP - TRACK; 72111 unaccompanied personnel housing.
USACE Army facilities unit-cost table: 14114 CIDC field operations building; five-digit CATCD per DA Pam 415-28.
AR 415-28 Real Property Category Codes: the five-digit CATCODE system used in the CATCODE column.
Fort Cavazos Installation Custodial Service sources sought (PANMCC-25-P-0000015172): one installation custodial requirement with a separate PWS. Scale anchor only.
Summary of the same notice: roughly 500 to 600 government facilities. Basis for testing at 400+ buildings.

Fort Benning grounds maintenance sources sought: about 184,000 acres of improved, semi-improved and unimproved grounds, excluding the golf course, cemetery, airfield and some MWR areas. Basis for the three-category acreage layout and the NOT IN SCOPE golf course row.
Improved grounds (intensive maintenance) and semi-improved grounds (mowed occasionally) definitions, paraphrased on the Notes sheet.

provenance.notes: Generated by gen.mjs (seeded mulberry32 PRNG, seed 4202027). All other CATCODE assignments (61050, 73017, 74028, 74046, 55010, 54010, 44220, 44224, 44260, 21110, 21910, 17120, 17150, 73010, 73046, 73070, 73075, 74010, 74021, 74044, 74047, 74055, 12410, 14112, 14113, 14171, 17890-17892) are plausible but not verified against DA Pam 415-28. No public Army facility-list exhibit was downloadable, so the column layout follows the other fixtures and common Technical Exhibit practice, not a specific document.

traps: Scale: 428 listed facility rows, 420 in scope, 12,635,779 gross SF in total. Gross SF runs from 120 (RANGE 03 latrine, gatehouse booth) to 250,000 (installation warehouse). Readers and the 3D campus must handle 400+ buildings without truncation, paging limits or dropping rows.

Names repeat: 66 x "COMPANY OPERATIONS FACILITY (COF)", 42 x "UEPH BARRACKS", 23 x "ORGANIZATIONAL STORAGE BLDG", 22 x "TACTICAL EQUIPMENT MAINT FACILITY (TEMF)", 22 x "GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE". 262 in-scope rows share a name with at least one other row. Only the building number tells them apart, so de-duplicating by name collapses hundreds of buildings.

Two-row merged header: "AREA (SQUARE FEET)" is merged over GROSS and CLEANABLE. ITEM (1..N) is a row counter, not a building number. CATCODE is a 5-digit number cell (e.g. 72111) and must not be read as square feet. BLDG NO. is a number cell for plain 5-digit numbers and a text cell for suffixed or T-prefixed numbers.

Zone section rows ("ZONE 2 - NORTH TROOP AREA", merged across) are headers, not facilities. Six "ZONE n SUBTOTAL - n FACILITIES IN SCOPE" rows and a "GRAND TOTAL - 420 FACILITIES IN SCOPE" row (12,635,779 SF) are not facilities.

8 rows are listed with SF but marked NOT IN SCOPE in Remarks (frequency N/A) and are excluded from truth and from the printed subtotals: 10804 ADMIN GEN PURPOSE (WWII WOOD) (VACANT - PENDING DISPOSAL - NOT IN SCOPE); 10807 SHOPPETTE (AAFES) (AAFES MAINTAINED - NOT IN SCOPE); 10813 BOWLING CENTER (NAF FACILITY - MWR CUSTODIAL - NOT IN SCOPE); 21917 UEPH BARRACKS (ROLLING PIN) (DEMOLISHED FY26 - NOT IN SCOPE); 31839 UEPH BARRACKS (UNDER RENOVATION THRU FY28 - NOT IN SCOPE); 40133 GENERAL PURPOSE WAREHOUSE (DEMOLISHED FY25 - NOT IN SCOPE); 50042 AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE HANGAR (TRANSFERRED TO ARNG AASF - NOT IN SCOPE); 93101 RANGE 31 ZERO LATRINE (RANGE CLOSED - NOT IN SCOPE).

Building numbers with a letter suffix (TEMF storage annexes such as 20150A next to TEMF 20150) are separate facilities from the TEMF with the same digits. Relocatable buildings use T-prefixed numbers (T32001, T32003, T32004, T32007).

Cleanable SF is far below gross for UEPH barracks (common areas only, about 18-26%), TEMFs (12-20%), hangars, shops and warehouses (office/latrine areas only), and DFACs (kitchen by the food service contractor). Do not default cleanable to gross.

Custodial frequency is a code (7X/WK, 5X/WK, 3X/WK, 2X/WK, 1X/WK, BI-WKLY, 1X/MO, QTRLY) defined on the Notes sheet: 7X/WK -> daily_7, 5X/WK -> daily_5, BI-WKLY -> biweekly, 1X/MO -> monthly, QTRLY -> quarterly. The Notes sheet "SERVICES PER YEAR" numbers (365, 250, ...) are not facilities.
RESTROOM FIXTURES is blank for buildings without restrooms (towers, storage buildings, some gatehouses); truth leaves restroomFixtures out for those.

Grounds sheet: two-row header with "ACRES BY GROUNDS CATEGORY" merged over IMPROVED / SEMI-IMPROVED / UNIMPROVED; a dash means zero. In-scope totals: improved 580.67 AC, semi-improved 3741.26 AC, unimproved 117197.1 AC. C-7 FAMILY HOUSING (RCI), C-8 GOLF COURSE (NAF) and IA-1 IMPACT AREA (DUDDED) are NOT IN SCOPE. The TOTAL ACRES column, the two SUBTOTAL rows and the GRAND TOTAL row must not be added again.

Unimproved training-area acreage (tens of thousands of acres) is in scope here and dominates total acres. A reader that drops it, or that also adds the 17,000+ acre impact area, is far off on unimproved acres.
No dining workload (meals/day) is given; DFAC rows are custodial only, so truth asserts no dining profile.
